title: John catena rem: signs, discourse, and the Father’s works
english: Middle catena scraps on John’s Gospel treat signs and speeches so that works and words together show the Son doing the [[Father’s works >> Bible:John 5:19-20]] and giving life to whom he will.

added_allusions.reason: Son does what he sees the Father doing

translator_notes: Copy-text: First1KGreek / OpenGreekAndLatin Origen catena & scholia TEI (tlg2042.tlg006/017/077/078). PD.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Gospel catena fragment series (lockable Greek). Pauline Gregg/Ramsbotham deferred until PD text locked locally.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
